newsitem.title: GHANA: Four killed in Ghana land dispute clash.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in Ghana land dispute clash.

text.p: Four people were killed and 14 injured during a clash over land between two communities in Ghana's Ashanti region, police said on Saturday.
Police commander Yaw Adu Gyima, quoted by state-run Ghana News Agency, said order had been restored after Friday's clash between the towns of Nsuta and Beposo.
Rival townsfolk clashed with shot-guns, machetes and other weapons at a new demarcation line proposed by the chief of Beposo. Three of the dead were from Beposo.
"Police reinforcements have been sent to the area which is now back to normalcy," the commander said.
Such clashes are frequent in Ghana.
